name: Wastewater Treatment (neutralization)
description: The wastewater neutralization of a surface-treatment shop: a mixed tank taking the rinses' overflow, its pH probe and flow meter, the acid and the caustic dosing pumps. Reports the pH and the flow; its dosing pumps switched on / off. Driven by the `shop-utilities` process (simulated - the rinses' acid drag-out, the dosing).
